Hi Samantha —

Great to meet you and Paul on the call earlier. As promised, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) to capture owners and target dates so we can get the pilot moving without back-and-forth. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: 8-week evaluation of Redwood inference on parallel testcases (latency-sensitive routing + cost controls)
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency under 150ms for production traffic profile; cost <= $0.12/token equivalent on baseline workload
- Key constraints: data residency for production logs, SOC-2 evidence for compliance team

Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_Finneo_v1.pdf (outline + suggested owners/timeline). My asks:

1) Can you confirm an internal owner for each row in the table (technical lead, security reviewer, procurement lead)?
2) Can you confirm target dates (we proposed milestone dates in column C; feel free to adjust) — if priorities shifted, let me know and we can re-sequence.
3) If helpful I can run a 20-minute alignment call to finalize owners/dates — I have slots Thu 2/26 11:30–12:00 or Mon 3/1 9:00–9:30 PT.

Next steps from our side: I’ll reserve a sandbox cluster for the test and prep an onboarding checklist once owners/dates are confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
